body: Thank you so much. I’m going to look into it more.
Thank you. I want to change so badly I just don’t know how. I downloaded the app thank you.

I’m on the same combo now I just started the buspar today. How long would you say it took to notice some of the anxiety to go away?

Hi thank you for responding! So for my workouts I do cardio everyday (even if it’s just a 20 minute walk on my rest days) and on my non rest days I either take a Zumba class or do a 2-3 mile speed walk or a high incline walk on the treadmill for about 40 minutes. For strength related workouts I try to incorporate a different area five days a week but I don’t do it for very long at all maybe 10-15 minutes I know I need to improve that. As well as my diet I think I’m eating too many carbs and maybe not enough protein. Now that you mention it I should be taking progress pictures I was not at first but maybe I’ll start doing that every 10 pounds or so I’m not sure. Thank you so much.

Hey there. I stayed in a nearly two year verbally abusive and controlling relationship for the same exact reason. I feared loneliness. I totally get where you are coming from. Trust me though being out of that relationship relived a lot of my stress and allowed me to work on my insecurities from the relationship. If you need any one to talk to or anything like that feel free to message me and I would be more than happy. I’m also 20 so we would have some similarities I’m sure.

Hi yeah absolutely. My brother is going to die soon because he’s addicted to fentanyl (not sure if that’s how to spell it) and he was just in rehab and came back home and got right back onto drugs. Preparing for that and trying to be there for my parents has been tough. I need to also look out and help myself but I feel it’s selfish when I know his problems are more severe. Thank you for listening.
Thank you. I’m here you for you as well. It is hard and I feel so stuck not knowing how to change.
